utme_requirements:
The Minimum entry requirements into National Diploma (ND) in Office Technology & Management are Five (5) Credits passes in WASC/NECO /GCE Oâ€™level/SSCE/NABTEB Examination at not more than two (2) sittings.

The subjects must include:

1.    English Language;

2.    Mathematics;

3.    And any other three (3) of the following:

Agricultural Science/Biology/Physics/Chemistry/Animal Husbandry, Economics, Financial Accounting/Principles of Accounts/Book Keeping, History/Government/Civic Education,  CRS/IRS, Information and Communication Technology (ICT)/Computer Studies/Data Processing, Office Practice, Shorthand, Typewriting, Literature-in-English, Commerce, Store Keeping/Store Management, Entrepreneurship Education.

iii)Â FEDPOIDA does not accept any other Language apart from English Language but &sq;O&sq; Level credit pass in Mathematics is compulsory.

iv)Â OGUN-POLY requires four (4) &sq;O&sq; Level credit passes at one sitting or five (5) credits at two (2) sittings.

v)Â FEDPONEK requires &sq;O&sq; Level credit pass in English Language, a Science subject and any three (3) of Economics, Business Methods, literature in English, Commerce, History, Government, Statistics, Geography, CRS, Principles of Accounts/Accounting, Office Practice/Secretarial Duties, Typewriting and Information Communication Technology, Mathematics or any language. &sq;O&sq; Level pass in Mathematics is compulsory.

viii)Â OZORO accepts &sq;O&sq; Level pass in Mathematics.
